candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show every checkout failure is caused by an upstream 500 from order, not a gateway fault.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order-service 500s in traces and logs; gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). The proximate cause is order returning 500, but the internal fault in order is not yet evidenced, so the bounded candidate is http-500 at the order boundary.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
